checks.name: 1 handshake + three tools discovered
1 server runs as a child process
1 no tool exposes tenant/scope/actor/root parameters
2 memory_remember committed=true
3 memory_get returns the exact memory by key
3 evidence is labelled untrusted and no answer generated
4 memory_find surfaces the memory for a natural-language question
5 server process terminated on client close
5 SQLite store exists on disk after the process ended
6 fresh server process launched (new pid)
7 original memory retrieved by a fresh process
8 wrong (near-miss) key refused: not_found_or_unavailable, no content
8 never-written key refused: not_found_or_unavailable
8 conflicting key: get serves exactly the head (latest write), latest_for_key=true, key_state_version is an int, earlier generations not enumerated, caveat present
8 conflicting key: find marks the head latest_for_key=true, the earlier value latest_for_key=false, and lists the key under non_head_keys
9 empty key -> MCP tool error (is_error=True, no structured success)
9 max_items out of range -> MCP tool error (is_error=True, no structured success)
9 oversize text -> MCP tool error (is_error=True, no structured success)
9 unknown tool name -> MCP error
8 after restart: get still serves exactly the head with latest_for_key=true
8 after restart: find marks head true and earlier value false
8 other scope cannot read the key: not_found_or_unavailable, no content
8 other scope cannot find the content: empty evidence
8 other tenant cannot read the key (error or empty, never the content)
9 missing host configuration -> MCP tool error naming host configuration, no traceback
final: no server process left running
